# Waveform picture over the cleaned dialogue

The cleaned dialogue from the dialogue-cleanup clip turned into a picture: mgvideo waveform draws the sound twice, in brown and in sand, and the brown version fills in from left to right as the audio plays, like a social audiogram.

- Type: Audio waveform
- Skill: `magnifito-audio`
- Engine: `waveform`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f23-waveform.mp4`](../videos/f23-waveform.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Take the cleaned half of ../videos/f22-dialogue-cleanup.mp4 (the last 6 seconds) and make an audiogram for social: draw its waveform with mgvideo waveform, once in Magnifito brown #7a584c (played) and once in sand #d8c6b4 (still to play), and set it in a white card on the cream background (card.svg, Geist from fonts/). The brown waveform should fill in from left to right in time with the sound.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f23-waveform
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f23-waveform/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 6 -t 6 -i ../videos/f22-dialogue-cleanup.mp4 -vn -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le work/clean.wav
mgvideo waveform work/clean.wav --width 1600 --height 1500 --color '#7a584c' --out work/wave-played.png
mgvideo waveform work/clean.wav --width 1600 --height 1500 --color '#d8c6b4' --out work/wave-ahead.png
node rasterize.mjs card.svg work/card.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/card.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/wave-played.png -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 6 -i work/wave-ahead.png -i work/clean.wav -filter_complex "color=c=0xfbf8f3:s=1600x360:r=30:d=6,format=rgba,split[c1][c2];[c1][1:v]overlay=0:-570,format=gbrp[played];[c2][2:v]overlay=0:-570,format=gbrp[ahead];[played][ahead]blend=all_expr='if(lt(X,W*T/6),A,B)'[wave];[0:v][wave]overlay=160:390,format=yuv420p[v];[3:a]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/audiogram.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/audiogram.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
